$comment: Classification of AL-Go actions by how safely they can be invoked in isolation by the issue-triage repro harness. Used by Tests/Repro/Invoke-ActionRepro.ps1 and by the triage agent when deciding whether a Tier 1 repro is possible. Keep in sync with the Actions/ folder.

classes.offline: Deterministic. Reads and writes files only. Safe to run anywhere with no credentials.
classes.needs-api: Requires read-only GitHub API access. Safe to run with the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN.
classes.needs-network: Reaches external endpoints (bcartifacts, template repositories, aldoc). Safe but slower and may be flaky.
classes.unsafe: Requires BC containers, real secrets, or live tenants. Never invoked by the repro harness without -Force.
